name: deepseek-v4-flash-pro6000ws-384k
notes: RTX PRO 6000 WS 2-GPU dev profile for unsloth/DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B total, 13B activated, FP4+FP8 mixed). Follows DeepSeek V4 serving guidance where applicable for non-disaggregated dev: tokenizer/tool/reasoning parser deepseek_v4, block-size 256, FP4 indexer cache, compilation config FULL_AND_PIECEWISE, and MTP speculative decoding with 3 tokens. Uses max_model_len=393216 to support Think Max without truncation per the model card. TP=2 is required to split the ~160GB checkpoint across two 90GB RTX PRO 6000 WS GPUs; this is dev-oriented and less optimal than the recommended 4-GPU DP/EP production topology.
